data.name: Ashir
data.gender_notes: Ashir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who is content and satisfied with what Allah has given them. The name Ashir carries the meaning “Content, pleased, satisfied” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ashir usually hope their child will grow to embody content, pleased, satisfied and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A sign of Allah's blessings and grace
data.etymology: Ashir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Content, pleased, satisfied.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ashir total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: عاشر
in_arabic.meaning: العاشر من العدد، العاشر من الشهر، العاشر من السنة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فاعل من عشرة، يدل على من بلغ العاشرة من العمر أو من الشهر أو من السنة، ويعني الشخص الذي يعيش في العاشر من أي فترة، وقد وردت هذه الكلمة في القرآن الكريم في سياق الحديث عن أهل الجنة والنار، مما يدل على أهميته في الثقافة الإسلامية

in_urdu.name: عاشر
in_urdu.meaning: دسویں نمبر پر، دسویں مہینے میں، دس سال کا
in_urdu.long_meaning: عاشر کا مطلب ہے دس کا شمار، دسویں نمبر پر آنے والا، دسویں مہینے یا سال میں پیدا ہونے والا، یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں مہینوں کے ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، اور یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں شائع ہے

in_hindi.name: आशिर
in_hindi.meaning: दसवें नंबर पर, दसवें महीने में, दस साल का
in_hindi.long_meaning: आशिर नाम का अर्थ है दस का आंकड़ा, दसवें नंबर पर आने वाला, दसवें महीने या साल में जन्मने वाला, यह नाम इस्लामी कैलेंडर में महीनों के नामों में से एक है, और यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में प्रचलित है

in_pashto.name: عاشر
in_pashto.meaning: لسم نمبر، لسم میاشت کې، لس کلنۍ
in_pashto.long_meaning: عاشر د لسم نمبر معنی لري، د لسمې میاشتې یا کال په لسمه ورځ زیږیدلی، دا نوم د اسلامي تقویم په میاشتو کې یو له نومونو څخه دی، او دا نوم د افغان او پښتون قومونو په دودیزو نومونو کې شامل دی

in_english.name: Ashir
in_english.meaning: tenth, one who reaches the tenth year or month
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ashir originates from the Arabic root 'ع-ش-ر' meaning 'ten', it refers to someone who has reached the tenth year, month or stage, the name holds significance in Islamic tradition as it relates to the counting of time and stages of life, and is used across various Muslim cultures

data.cultural_impact: The name Ashir in the Islamic culture represents the essence of gratitude towards the blessings that Allah bestows upon us. Ashirs are individuals who spiritual maturity enables them to appreciate and appreciate life's blessings, leading to a state of contentment and satisfaction. In the Muslim society, displaying this quality is admirable, as it reflects one's inner peace and tranquility. It also symbolizes a sense of detachment from worldly possessions and a reminder to focus on the eternal sustenance that Allah provides.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Ashir signifies a deep, unwavering commitment to Allah, wherein an individual derives their contentment and satisfaction solely from the pleasure of their Creator. It signifies a fundamental understanding of the transient nature of worldly possessions versus the eternal rewards of the Hereafter. Choosing the name Ashir for a child is a reminder to strive for spiritual advancement, to be grateful for Allah's blessings, and to remain steadfast in seeking His pleasure throughout their life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Content, pleased, satisfied" symbolizes A person who is content and satisfied with what Allah has given them. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Ashir serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of content, pleased, satisfied.
